submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on tokens of text that the model can reproduce word for word: memorized boilerplate (software license headers, copyright and 'all rights reserved' notices, cookie, reCAPTCHA and blog-footer notices, Wikipedia stub templates such as 'is a village in the administrative district of Gmina ...') and the second verbatim copy of a multi-sentence passage already present earlier in the context; it fires strongest several tokens into such a span and holds roughly level across it. It is not broad: novel prose (all 22 ordinary sentences measured, peak at most 0.15 x max), the first occurrence of a passage, and ordinary non-boilerplate code are predicted inactive.
